questions.question: The values match NumPy, but the output array is on CPU when the requested platform was TPU. What has been demonstrated?
options: The TPU installation and its execution are validated.
The arithmetic matches the reference on the fallback CPU backend, so the requested TPU backend was not active.
The model must be numerically wrong.
questions.explanation: A correct value can be produced on the wrong device. Require both reference agreement and the output placement before recording a successful target run.
